promptVersions.conceptZh: 「水」字化成四筆清楚的藍色小水道，紙船順著中央豎鉤漂流，在鉤尾輕輕轉彎。
promptVersions.object: A cobalt-blue watercourse shaped precisely like 水, with one tiny yellow paper boat.
promptVersions.morph: Begin with the complete glyph. Water moves inside its four fixed stroke silhouettes; the central vertical hook carries a tiny boat, while the three surrounding strokes remain separate, clearly defined channels. Surface details gradually disappear into a solid blue glyph.
promptVersions.creativeAngle: 從完整字形出發，把中央豎鉤變成紙船的轉彎水道；用小船轉向的驚喜凸顯鉤筆，避免水花變字造成筆畫模糊。
promptVersions.promptEn:
Create an exactly 8-second animation teaching the Traditional Chinese character 水 to a Taiwanese child aged 6–8. Use a locked, straight-on overhead view against a warm, pale cream background. From the first frame, show one correctly formed 水, centered and uncropped, approximately 70% of frame height with generous margins. Base its exact four-stroke silhouette on a standard Traditional Chinese educational typeface. Render those strokes as saturated cobalt-blue enamel water channels with shallow water inside; preserve every stroke boundary and the open spaces between strokes throughout.

At 0.6 seconds, a tiny yellow paper boat appears within the top of the central vertical stroke. It drifts downward, making the meaning of water tangible. Restrained ripples travel separately along the left bent stroke, upper-right short falling stroke, and lower-right sweeping stroke, without connecting their channels or extending beyond their silhouettes. At 2.8 seconds, the boat reaches the central hook: the current gently turns its pointed bow along the hook, giving it a charming little change of direction. Keep the boat small enough that the blue stroke remains clearly readable around it. By 4.2 seconds, dissolve the boat and internal ripples while smoothly flattening the enamel shading. From 4.2 through 8.0 seconds, hold the resulting solid cobalt-blue 水 completely still and unobstructed for 3.8 full seconds.

A warm adult voice clearly pronounces 水 four times in Taiwanese Mandarin, shuǐ, ㄕㄨㄟˇ, with a natural isolated third tone, beginning at 0.2, 2.1, 4.6, and 6.6 seconds. Use soft water sounds beneath the action, quiet during speech and silent during the final hold. The watercourse is a playful visual metaphor, not an explanation of historical etymology. Keep the composition bright but not neon, with no camera movement, flashing effects, additional writing, subtitles, logos, watermarks, or background props.

promptVersions.morph: The main stream flows downward to carve the central hooked vertical stroke, while branching streamlets fill the left angled stroke and right falling/sweeping strokes of the glyph.
promptVersions.creativeAngle: 區隔於前一版的紙船漂流設計，改採用竹管泉水自然湧流與動態分流的實體物理隱喻。藉由中央主水流與兩側分支水流精準勾勒出「水」字的四個筆畫，並在流動完成後迅速凝固為飽和的鈷藍色字體，達成筆順清晰度與長達3.2秒的穩定定格。
promptVersions.promptEn: Create an exactly 8-second animation teaching the Traditional Chinese character 水 to a Taiwanese child aged 6–8. Use a locked, straight-on overhead camera angle against a warm, pale cream porcelain background. Centered in the frame, a smooth miniature bamboo spout positioned at the top center releases a sparkling stream of translucent aqua-blue spring water. At 0.4 seconds, the main water stream glides vertically downward, curving gently at the bottom to form the central hooked vertical stroke (豎鉤). At 1.8 seconds, two smaller trickles branch out from the main stream: one glides to the left to form the angled stroke (橫撇), while the other flows right, splitting into the upper-right falling stroke (撇) and lower-right sweeping stroke (捺). The water streams fill the precise four-stroke silhouette of a standard Traditional Chinese educational typeface for 水, maintaining distinct stroke boundaries without spilling over. At 3.6 seconds, the bamboo spout smoothly retracts upward out of frame while the flowing water inside the four strokes instantly settles into a solid, vibrant cobalt-blue enamel glyph. From 4.8 seconds to 8.0 seconds, hold the completed, solid blue 水 character completely still and unobstructed for a full 3.2-second final hold, occupying approximately 70% of the frame height with clean margins. A warm adult voice clearly pronounces 水 four times in Taiwanese Mandarin, shuǐ, ㄕㄨㄟˇ, with a natural isolated third tone, at 0.2, 2.0, 4.6, and 6.6 seconds. Soft, relaxing water trickling sounds accompany the liquid animation, turning silent during the final hold. Keep the lighting bright and warm, with zero camera motion, flashing effects, subtitles, extra text, logos, or watermarks.

promptVersions.conceptZh: 在溫馨明亮的園藝工坊中，一塊長條狀的濕潤黑土作為寬大的底部橫畫。滴入一滴水後，黑土中央驚喜地向上抽出一根筆直的褐色幼苗幹（豎畫），接著幼苗頂端平緩展開一對小木牌般的水平橫枝（較短的上橫畫），三者自然融合成結構標準、線條飽滿的「土」字。

promptVersions.morph: The wide soil bed forms the longer bottom horizontal stroke; a single water droplet causes a central soil stem to grow upward as the vertical stroke, while two horizontal wooden leaf-tags extend out to create the shorter top horizontal stroke, seamlessly fusing into the character '土'.
promptVersions.creativeAngle: 擺脫過去「鏟子插土並壓平」的機械拼貼模式，改以「土壤發芽成長」的自然生態因果作為核心比喻。下長橫為養分土壤，中豎為茁壯幹莖，上短橫為水平伸展的雙枝，呈現生動且符合字形比例（上短下長）的筆順動態，搭配溫柔的台灣國語發音與長達 3.5 秒的靜止定格。
promptVersions.promptEn:
An 8-second 3D literacy animation designed for 6-8-year-old children teaching the Traditional Chinese character '土' (earth). Set in a warm, brightly lit garden workspace against a clean, uncluttered pastel beige background with soft studio shadows.

[0.0s - 1.5s]: Centered in frame, a smooth, wide rectangular slab of dark, rich potting soil rests horizontally along the lower third of the scene, establishing the long bottom horizontal stroke. A single glossy water drop falls into the exact middle of the soil base with a gentle ripple.

[1.5s - 3.0s]: Triggered by the drop, a sleek vertical sprout of rich brown terracotta clay grows straight upward from the center, forming the sturdy vertical stroke (丨). Near its upper section, two wooden garden marker tabs smoothly extend left and right, forming a neat, shorter horizontal crossbar (一).

[3.0s - 4.5s]: The plant bed, terracotta stem, and wooden crossbar seamlessly merge and smooth into a crisp, vibrant, saturated chocolate-brown Traditional Chinese glyph '土'. The top horizontal stroke is visibly shorter than the wide bottom foundation stroke. The finished character fills approximately 70% of the screen height, perfectly centered with clean margins around all edges.

[4.5s - 8.0s]: The character '土' remains completely static and rock-steady for a 3.5-second final hold. Clear, warm Taiwanese Mandarin voiceover distinctly pronounces 'ㄊㄨˇ' (tǔ) four times in a friendly, encouraging rhythm ('ㄊㄨˇ, ㄊㄨˇ, ㄊㄨˇ, ㄊㄨˇ'). Clean visual composition without watermarks, floating text, or flashing effects.

promptVersions.creativeAngle: 回歸「器」字本義與字形結構（四口一犬），以「四方形餐具+守護器皿的小狗」作為具象化隱喻，趣味展現器皿與工具概念，兼具文字學幾何特徵與兒童動畫視覺吸引力。
promptVersions.promptEn:
An 8-second 3D literacy animation for 6-8 year old Taiwanese children introducing the Traditional Chinese character 器 (qì, meaning vessels and tools).

[00:00 - 02:00] Staging & Intro: On a clean, warm light-beige table, four square turquoise ceramic snack dishes are arranged in a balanced 2x2 grid. In the central space between them stands a playful brown puppy wearing a tiny red apron and holding a small wooden spoon, forming the central figure. The composition is brightly lit with soft warm lighting, keeping the scene uncluttered and perfectly centered.

[00:02 - 04:00] Transformation & Metaphor: The puppy happily barks 'Qi! Qi!' while tapping each dish with its wooden spoon. The four square dishes cleanly flatten into four bold, saturated dark-navy square strokes (口 at top-left, top-right, bottom-left, and bottom-right). Simultaneously, the puppy stretches gracefully into the central stroke assembly of 犬 (a horizontal stroke, sweeping diagonal legs, and a distinct top-right dot stroke). Every stroke connects precisely according to Traditional Chinese orthography.

[00:04 - 05:00] Final Assembly: The strokes lock together smoothly to form the complete, perfectly balanced Traditional Chinese glyph 器. The character fills 70% of the frame height, centered against the clean background with ample margins.

[00:05 - 08:00] Extended Hold & Audio: The solid dark-navy character 器 holds completely static for 3 full seconds without camera motion, drift, or distracting effects. Over clear background ambience, an authentic Taiwanese Mandarin child voiceover clearly repeats 'ㄑㄧˋ! ㄑㄧˋ! ㄑㄧˋ! 器 (qì) - 器皿的器!' three to four times.

promptVersions.conceptZh: 一隻俏皮的機械玩具機器人興奮開啟四周四個方形工具盒，身體與工具盒順暢演變成「器」字。
promptVersions.object: A colorful mechanical toy robot and four square tool trays
promptVersions.morph: The four tool trays flatten into the four 口 square strokes, while the toy robot's springy frame stretches into the central 犬 strokes to form the character 器.
promptVersions.creativeAngle: 回應家長「機器人」與「生動搞笑」的需求，利用玩具機器人過度興奮引發的彈跳拉伸動作創造喜劇笑點，精準對應「器」字的四口一犬結構。
promptVersions.promptEn:
An 8-second 3D animation introducing the Traditional Chinese character 器 (qì).

[00:00 - 00:02] Staging & Setup:
On a clean, brightly lit light-cream surface, four square turquoise toy tool trays are arranged in a symmetric 2x2 grid. In the center between the trays stands a chunky, colorful mechanical toy robot with springy joints and round glowing eyes. The composition is uncluttered, brightly lit with soft shadows, keeping the subjects centered.

[00:02 - 00:04.5] Visual Gag & Transformation:
The toy robot enthusiastically presses a red chest button to showcase its gadgets. With a funny springy boing, the four square tool trays pop open and neatly flatten into four bold, dark-indigo square strokes (口 at top-left, top-right, bottom-left, and bottom-right). Surprised by the sudden pop, the toy robot's mechanical frame hilariously stretches out—its arms extend into a solid horizontal bar, its legs sweep into diagonal legs, and its antenna pops up as a neat top-right dot, forming the central 犬 component.

[00:04.5 - 00:08.0] Assembly & 3.5-Second Hold:
The strokes lock together seamlessly to complete the precise Traditional Chinese glyph 器. The dark-indigo glyph fills roughly 70% of the frame height, centered against the warm, clean background with clear margins. The glyph stays completely static with no motion or camera drift for the final 3.5 seconds.

Audio:
An off-screen voice speaks clearly in Taiwanese Mandarin: "器、器、機器人" (qì, qì, jī qì rén), timed naturally with the finished glyph display. There are no subtitles, on-screen vocabulary text, or distracting background music.
